messages:
maria (People Ops): Post-all-hands follow-up: a few quick Qs about hybrid etiquette, travel reimbursement, and offsite childcare that came up. I'll capture answers here so we have one place to link.

kai (Eng): For commuter rides to the satellite office (short trips under 10 miles) can we use ride-share and expense without pre-approval?

sam (COO): Yes for single-day commutes under $60 total. Use Expensify, tag as "local_commute". Anything over $60 or multiple trips in one day needs manager pre-approval.

maria (People Ops): Adding: international teammates should ask People Ops before booking to confirm country-specific rules.

nina (Design): Desk booking question: can teams reserve a block of desks for a design sprint (3 days)? What notice is needed?

henry (Facilities): You can request a team block via the office-request form. Minimum lead time is 10 business days for blocks larger than 4 desks. For 3-day sprints under 4 desks, 5-day notice is fine. We keep 15% of desks unscheduled for drop-ins.

kai (Eng): Are recurring weekly reservations allowed? e.g., our team wants Tuesdays every other week for pairing.

maria (People Ops): Recurring reservations are allowed but limited: max once per week per team and need manager sign-off. Exceptions for long-term remote-to-hybrid transitions can be requested and are reviewed monthly.

finance-bot: Reminder: Please include the project code in expenses to avoid delays.

sam (COO): Offsite planning: Product org is aiming for a 2-day working offsite in late July - exact dates tbd. We're looking at partial travel stipends for teammates traveling internationally.

maria (People Ops): Childcare stipend pilots: People Ops is testing a $150 one-time stipend for caregivers attending company-funded offsites. Pilot applies to the July product offsite and requires receipts. Will confirm by end of week.

nina (Design): Will there be a shuttle or assistance for airport transfers? Some folks flying into unfamiliar airports.

henry (Facilities): Tentatively exploring a shared shuttle from the main airport and negotiated rates with partner hotels. Final details in the offsite logistics doc when approved.

kai (Eng): Etiquette q: if we have an in-person sprint kickoff, should we default to no-recording and live transcripts only?

sam (COO): Good rule of thumb: announce recording in the invite; prefer live transcripts for accessibility. If external guests present, get consent first.

maria (People Ops): Actions: I'll update the People Ops FAQ with: expense caps, booking lead times, recurring reservation process, childcare pilot details, and links to forms. Will ping managers when the offsite dates are firm. Thanks! :thumbsup:

kai (Eng): Thanks, appreciate it.

nina (Design): Thanks :heart: 

henry (Facilities): Will post a seating layout for SF hub tomorrow.
